summary.title: Property type summary
summary.body_html: Branded residences in Dubai are residential properties connected to a hospitality, design, fashion or luxury brand. They usually fit buyers who value lifestyle, service, prestige, design, managed amenities and long-term luxury positioning rather than only the lowest price.

property_logic.title: Property type logic
property_logic.body: Primadom AI should not rank branded residences only by brand name. The shortlist should compare developer, district, brand relevance, unit layout, view, service charges, rental restrictions, payment plan, handover, resale audience and competing luxury supply.

items.title: Palm Jumeirah
items.text: Strong for resort-style luxury, waterfront views, beach access and global brand appeal.

items.title: Downtown Dubai
items.text: Useful for urban luxury, hospitality, landmark views and branded high-rise residences.

items.title: Business Bay / Marasi
items.text: Relevant for hotel-linked residences, canal lifestyle and central access.

items.title: Jumeirah Bay / waterfront zones
items.text: Ultra-prime positioning where scarcity and brand identity matter more than entry price.

price_range.title: Price range
price_range.body: Branded residences usually sit above ordinary apartments in the same district. Price range depends on brand, developer, location, view, floor, unit size, service level and availability. Buyers should compare total price, service charges and holding cost, not only headline price.

decision_cards.title: Prestige plus liquidity filter
decision_cards.text: Brand can help positioning, but resale depends on price, unit, service cost and buyer demand.

decision_cards.title: Service and identity matter
decision_cards.text: The value is often in amenities, design, hospitality standards and managed lifestyle.

decision_cards.title: Premium can be useful or expensive
decision_cards.text: Brand premium is only justified when service, location and product quality support it.

decision_cards.title: Find by budget and brand fit
decision_cards.text: Primadom AI can compare branded projects by district, brand, payment plan and buyer goal.

pros_cons.title: Pros and cons
cons_items: Higher entry price and possible brand premium
Service charges can reduce net yield
Not every branded project has the same resale logic

items.question: What are branded residences in Dubai?
items.answer: Branded residences are residential properties associated with a hospitality, design, fashion or luxury brand. Buyers should check the brand relationship, service model, fees, developer, location and resale logic before deciding.

items.question: Who should buy branded residences?
items.answer: They usually fit buyers who value lifestyle, service, design, prestige, managed amenities and long-term luxury positioning rather than only entry price.

items.question: Which areas are best for branded residences?
items.answer: Common areas include Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, Jumeirah Bay Island, Dubai Marina and selected waterfront or ultra-prime districts depending on availability.
